Hi everyone, 

I was doing some CFA with lavaan for ordinal data (actually binary, but correct & wrong). 

However, upon checking the results, I was a little bit confused by the standard, scaled, and robust results. 

Not sure how to report the overall fit here. 
Any comments are appreciated!

Warm regards, 
Jane

messages.author: 08e48595b188026f
messages.subject: Re: Interpreting CFA results with Ordinal Data
parts:
Hi Jane,

Typically, the results from the robust row (not column) are reported. You can find some information here: Two robust fit measures with MLR (google.com)

Note that for WLS family estimators (used for ordinal data), robust indicators are available only since lavaan version 6.13. I think that these indicators are based on the following paper Improving Fit Indices in Structural Equation Modeling with Categorical Data (tandfonline.com), but am not 100% as the lavaan documentation does not specify (only says "based on work done by Victoria Savalei and colleagues"; lavaan.org - 0.6 series (ugent.be))

Hope this helps!
Jošt
